title: InterACT International Postdoctoral Fellowships
about: Vrije Universiteit Brussel has opened the first call of InterACT, an international, interdisciplinary and intersectoral postdoctoral programme under Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions. Researchers from all scientific disciplines may apply. Applications close on 8 January 2027.
